tasks.design: Assemble only verified release-eligible files and technician-verified metadata into the repository's fixed package format deterministically. Retain metadata capture, substantive package validation, the existing release owner's final-package authorization, separate public upload and actual accession/exception recording; a changed package needs a new final authorization before any resubmission.

tasks.still_hard: Release permission, sample identity and meaningful metadata need research-team judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that a technically valid package exposes restricted information or misdescribes samples.
tasks.altitude: Validate traceable submission packages rather than manually arrange files.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed repository schemas, file manifests and checksums support deterministic package assembly after metadata and release eligibility are verified.

assumptions: Shares25/25/20/15/5/1/9 are provisional, not measured. tasks.design: Use native parameter forms for actually maintained administrative runbooks to reduce repeated command preparation. Retain troubleshooting, approach selection, full final-command checking, actual execution, outcome validation and written records; no model proposes or runs a system repair.

tasks.still_hard: Correct scope, dependencies and restoration readiness remain operational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a system state in which the usual runbook is inappropriate.
tasks.altitude: Check scoped operations instead of repeating stable command setup.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: parameterized native runbooks can reuse stable command structure while diagnosis, target validation and operation execution remain human.
